title: python/src/lichen/ccp.py: select_channel returns invalid channel indices for n_channels < 3
description:
The formula `n = max(n_channels - 1, 2)` forces n to be at least 2, so the function returns channels 1 or 2 regardless of n_channels. With n_channels=2, it can return channel 2 which doesn't exist. With n_channels=1 or 0, it returns channels 1-2 when no data channels exist at all.

Fix suggestion: Add validation: `if n_channels < 2: raise ValueError("n_channels must be at least 2")` or return 0 (fallback to CH0) when n_channels < 2.
